author: Rick Fritz
text: You know, you don’t have to use a CGM if you are having a challenge using it.  I find these recent complaints of the CGM accuracy questionable.  A month ago, there were very few complaints.  Once the recall happened, the haters, untrained, and bots are going nuts to get attention.  I’m not buying these sensors are failing this horribly so quickly.  I used Dexcom for 3 years and was much worse to the point now where FDA issued a warning letter awaiting Dexcom response.

text: It's best to look at your graph with an odd number, you can see straight away if it's not in the trend, wait 5 mins for next result, overall, it's better than not having it, believe me, diabetic for 50 years.
